effects.effect: Your god fills your body with the light of creation, making you harder to hurt and move. You gain a +6 bonus to [Stamina](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), and this bonus increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to [stability](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/stability).
